data: Boeing's blue IVA suit for the CST-100 Starliner, debuted on the Crew Flight Test 2024

Lightweight launch-entry pressure suit built by David Clark for Boeing's commercial-crew vehicle. Touch-screen-compatible gloves, integrated communications cap, vented helmet. Worn on the Starliner Crew Flight Test (Wilmore and Williams, June–September 2024).

Lightweight launch-entry pressure suit built by David Clark Company for Boeing's CST-100 Starliner commercial-crew vehicle. Touch-screen-compatible gloves, integrated communications cap, vented helmet. Debuted on the Crew Flight Test mission (June 2024) flown by Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams, who returned via Crew-9 in February 2025 after Starliner returned uncrewed.
The orange Shuttle pressure suit worn after Challenger made shirtsleeve ascent unacceptable
The white US spacewalk suit — every American EVA from the Shuttle to the ISS
The J-mission suit — added a waist joint so astronauts could sit in the Lunar Rover
The first operational lunar surface suit — Apollo 11 through 14
The white slim-fit Crew Dragon IVA suit, flown since Demo-2
The latest of a 50-year line of Russian rear-entry EVA suits
